objectives.text: Replace the manual new-based wiring of a controller, service and repository with Spring-managed components that receive their dependencies through constructors
Predict the startup outcome when a required bean is missing or when two beans match one injection point, and resolve the ambiguity with @Primary or @Qualifier
Explain why constructor injection keeps a class testable with plain new in a unit test

This worst path was modeled, not measured on these pages. budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, within the 15 minute cap.
